title.full: How un-nominated CPF money is shared

summary.text: The Public Trustee's Office distributes the money. The rules differ for Muslim and non-Muslim families.

details.heading: Non-Muslim families
details.body: The money follows the Intestate Succession Act. A spouse with no children or parents receives all. A spouse with children receives half, and the children share half. Children without a spouse receive all equally. Other family shares depend on which relatives survive.

details.heading: Muslim families
details.body: The money follows Islamic inheritance law. The Syariah Court issues an Inheritance Certificate showing who receives the money and each person's share.

quotes.text: When someone passed away, the Public Trustee's Office (PTO) distributes these savings to the beneficiary.
The distribution rules are different for Muslim and non-Muslim families because they follow different legal systems.
The Syariah Court will issue an Inheritance Certificate that lists down who are the beneficiary and how much each person receives.
